FN-T3C019-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 134
Committee: Health Sponsor: Representative Ed Oliver
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/18/2023
House Bill 134 as introduced would create the seven-member Alabama Assisted Living Board
of Mitigation with estimated minimum annual obligations of $2,800 for per diem expenses of
the board members. Further this bill could increase the administrative obligations of the
Alabama Department of Public Health to: (1) participate in hearings regarding disputes raised by
licensed assisted living facilities and specialty care assisted living facilities; and (2) notifying
assisted living facilities and specialty care assisted living facilites of their right to file a
complaint with this new board before suspending or revoking the facility's license.
